name: pancake_tags
description: List all tags configured on the Pancake page, or add/toggle a tag on a specific conversation (requires confirmMutation=true).

action.description: 'list' page tags (read-only) or 'add' a tag to a conversation (mutation)

target.description: Pancake conversation URL or ID (required when action='add')

tagNameOrId.description: Tag display name (e.g. 'QR Zalo', 'Doanh nghiệp') or tag ID (required when action='add')
